params.prompt: professional e-commerce product photo of a folded cashmere knit sweater showing the ribbed texture, cashmere knit with fine ribbed loops, on a seamless mid grey background, top light with bounce fill from a white board below, tight crop, subject filling the frame, macro detail, sharp focus, high detail, commercial grade, 8k

notes: 高 denoise 上限附近的取样点：针织纹理最容易被重绘改掉（D-38）。⚠️ 参考图在离线校验里由**桩 resolver** 提供，不证明素材能被引擎读到
